info.name: Workout Tracker API
info.description:
Complete API collection for Workout Tracker application. Tests all endpoints including authentication, workouts, and exercises.

Setup:
1. Run the collection in order (Auth first)
2. Login/Register sets the {{token}} variable automatically
3. Create operations set {{workoutId}} and {{exerciseId}} variables
